mentions.name: MatGoat
mentions.description: This app helps BJJ and martial arts academy owners manage attendance, payments, class schedules, and student progress. It aims to be a simpler, more focused alternative to generic gym software, built with feedback from real academies.
mentions.problem: Instructors lose a lot of time to administrative work, and generic gym software is too broad for martial arts academies.
mentions.audience: BJJ and martial arts academy owners and instructors
